task: Tell me one bus stop that is nearest to the intersection of main street and Amherst street in Altavista.
answer:
FINAL: Amherst and 7th is the nearest bus stop to Main Street and Amherst Avenue in Altavista (Google Maps labels the intersection “Amherst Ave & Main St”). Google Maps shows a 410-foot, two-minute walk via Amherst Avenue; the nearby Main Street Middle stop is 420 feet away.

Evidence: final.png shows the intersection, stop name, and 410-foot walking directions together. Sources: [Google Maps directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Amherst+Ave+%26+Main+St,+Altavista,+VA&origin_place_id=ChIJs3_rQXy2sokRqY07WabOqSc&destination=Amherst+and+7th,+Altavista,+VA&destination_place_id=ChIJAzqnGny2sokR7AKdqHGBHqo&travelmode=walking&hl=en); [comparison directions to Main Street Middle](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=37.1137115,-79.2828604&destination=37.1144507,-79.2817571&destination_place_id=ChIJ-YSKh3y2sokRt4arakl09qQ&travelmode=walking&hl=en).
